audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 why was the generic 'Purgatory online: top lane's long brawls now end at YOUR floor', which contradicts the Kled side on the same row and the whys[4] line that says his remount survives the execute.
audit.why: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140s at rank 1 with a 3500-unit range and a shield, and the passive restores Skaarl's health on remount. The realistic value of your R here is not the execute — it is the grounding.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten to sell the grounding rather than the execute; spikes[1].text given the same correction.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions were absent. First, Bear Trap on a Rope only yanks if the shackle survives — Riot's text says 'If shackled for a short duration, the target ... is yanked toward Kled', so breaking range denies the pull outright, and Locke's W grants exactly the Move Speed to do it. Second, Locke's R grounds, and both of Kled's escapes (E Jousting and his R charge) are dashes.
audit.why: The page told the reader to 'dodge the hook', which is only half of it — after it lands you still have a window, and Locke's own W is the tool. The grounding is the single reason Purgatory is worth casting into a champion who out-sustains the execute.
audit.corrected: Both written into report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, spikes[1].text and wants.you[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[0] is titled 'Hold E as an escape until the lane genuinely turns' but its body describes his hook and remount.
audit.why: Jousting can be recast to dash back through its initial target, so blinking away from Kled does not necessarily break the fight — the exit is only safe once his Q is on its 11s rank-1 timer.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d rewritten to match its title and state the recast.

edits.before: Purgatory online: top lane's long brawls now end at YOUR floor. Anyone who all-ins you under a third is volunteering for the totem.
edits.after: Purgatory lands but the remount answers the execute — the value is the grounding, which pins him inside the zone with no Jousting out.

edits.before: R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! gives Kled an engage speed boost and a mounted health bar, so even landing R Purgatory he re-mounts through your execute threshold and out-sustains your W self-damage in the extended fight.
edits.after: R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! gives Kled speed and a mounted health bar, so even a landed R Purgatory can be re-mounted through. The grounding still earns the cast: inside the zone his E Jousting and his charge are both switched off.

edits.before: Track Kled’s Bear Trap on a Rope: The hook starts his all-in — dodge it and disengage his remount. Commit only while it is down.
edits.after: Bear Trap only yanks if the shackle holds — break range with W's move speed. Purgatory grounds his E and his charge both.

edits.after: His Jousting recast dashes back through you, so an exit is only safe once his Q is on its 11s timer.
